A port city read through its colonial streets, its rock-cut caves and its living neighbourhoods.

Everything is arranged privately for you: dates, pace, hotels, transport and the language you are guided in. You receive a day-by-day itinerary and an itemised quotation before you commit.

What it covers

  • The Fort precinct
  • Victorian Gothic and Art Deco
  • Elephanta
  • Banganga and Bhuleshwar, or Kanheri

Day by day

  1. Day 1: The Fort precinct

    Arrival, and the architecture of the old Fort area.

  2. Day 2: Victorian Gothic and Art Deco

    Two centuries of building along South Mumbai's streets.

  3. Day 3: Elephanta

    The island caves, if the ferry is running that day.

  4. Day 4: Banganga and Bhuleshwar, or Kanheri

    A sacred tank and a market quarter, or the Buddhist caves in the national park.

Days can be added, removed or reordered. The final itinerary comes with your quotation.

Programmes in this journey

  • Mumbai Fort Precinct: Colonial Urban Form
  • Mumbai Art Deco and Victorian Gothic Walk
  • Elephanta: Shiva and Rock-Cut Architecture
  • Banganga Tank: Sacred Water and Neighbourhood
  • Bhuleshwar: Living Religious Streetscape
  • Kanheri Caves: Monastic Landscapes
